plugins.name: OpenCode Session Mapper
plugins.description: Forwards client conversation session ids (codex Session-Id/Thread-Id, claude X-Claude-Code-Session-Id, dsh X-Session-Affinity/X-DeepSeek-Harness-Session-Id) to OpenCode Zen as x-opencode-session with a session-id mirror, and completes the free-tier CLI fingerprint: x-opencode-client=cli, x-opencode-project=global, and a per-request x-opencode-request (msg_ + 12 hex + 14 base62), with a host-derived canonical_session_id fallback for clients that send no session header at all.
plugins.author: ahoo
